answers.core: The existence of a AtlasTexture resource seem frustrating if this is not added to the engine. Current AtlasTexture would always need an external json to be used properly. Seem like a waste.
answers.workaround: It can be worked around with an external tool that cuts the sprite sheet. But with files downloaded from the internet this may be inconvenient.

title: Allow cutting a spritesheet into an AtlasTexture automatically
